name: lab-unit

irregularities.action: Removed by the cleanup region, step 1.

cleanup: # At the unit's prompt type /N and Enter. For each step type the item numbers of its second column,
# one at a time with Enter after each, then what the arrow says. A pick: the number of the line
# that reads as shown. ESC goes back one level. A value is live as soon as its Enter is accepted.
#  2. ESC ESC  leave /N: wait for "Saving configuration to flash"
cleanup_after: # There is no other step for lab-unit: its first checklist is empty. Check that the pull is
# current (tacctl device config pull lab-unit --diff reads ok for aaa) and keep a second session
# Nothing rolls the cleanup back by itself. To put a value back: the read/write community is a
# string tacctl does not hold (re-enter the one you keep), and the other protocol's switch is
# Locked out (the paste cut your session and no login works)? A superuser runs: tacctl breakglass hold lab-unit --reason "..."
# then log in on the unit's serial console as its local Administrator account,
# fix or back out, and the superuser runs: tacctl breakglass release lab-unit
